title: Pin lagged-marker delivery before broadcaster shutdown drain
outcome: A deterministic broadcaster lifecycle regression proves that a pending lagged marker is forwarded before shutdown drains and stops, while preserving final retained publication ordering.
acceptance: A deterministic test enters Closing with a pending lagged flag and retained work, proves Lagged is forwarded before the final drain, and proves shutdown joins without losing retained work or spinning.
Focused lifecycle and overflow tests pass without timing sleeps or relaxed ordering, and the required review pair confirms the test exercises production mailbox/worker behavior.
